verdict.rationale: Lithic explicitly documents a sandbox environment that mirrors production for running cards, transactions, and webhooks end-to-end, with dedicated endpoints to simulate merchant/acquirer transaction events, and the MCP blog post shows an AI agent creating test cards, configuring rules, and running transactions against a sandbox account. This directly matches the ai-native story of testing safely without touching production data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation from a third party of sandbox fidelity and no explicit mention of sandbox API key isolation guarantees.
